prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1066; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above, and we ask that all further communication regarding this matter be directed to our office rather than to our client. Please do not contact our client directly by telephone, mail, or in person.

Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision and is currently receiving medical treatment. We are gathering records to support a full evaluation of the claim, and we will forward documentation as it becomes available.

To allow us to evaluate settlement options, please provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also request that your insurer preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair estimates, recorded statements, adjuster notes, and any electronic communications. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained.

We look forward to your prompt response.
